{{Top|leg}}
The '''Aqualish Regulars''' were an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] military unit that existed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ondon Kleero]] was an officer of the Aqualish Regulars.<ref name="SWG:TBOM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||The Blasted Overland Migration!}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Aqualish Regulars were mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBOM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
